# Keys

Lists the property names of an object.

## Signature

```jyro
# fragment
Keys(source)
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `source` | object | The object whose property names to list. Null is read as an empty object. Any other value that is not an object is a runtime error. |

## Returns

Array. An array of the property names, as strings, in the order the object holds them. The empty array for an empty object. Never null.

## Example

`Keys({"a": 1, "b": 2})` returns `["a", "b"]`.
